Class TileFactory.JsonTile

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.model.tiles.TileFactory.JsonTile
Enclosing class:
TileFactory
public static class TileFactory.JsonTile extends Object
Inner static class used for JSON deserialization of tiles. Contains fields that match the structure of tile entries in the JSON file.
